verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal AI coding agent that takes natural-language prompts. It documents troubleshooting-adjacent tools: web search for error messages, LSP diagnostics showing errors or warnings introduced by edits, and a read-only Explore mode for codebase questions. However, no dedicated debugging workflow is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit debugging/troubleshooting workflow (e.g., reproducing bugs, analyzing stack traces or logs, debugger integration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging effectiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: Search the web for documentation, error messages, package APIs, and other information.
Returns Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics showing any errors or warnings introduced by the edit.
Switch to Explore mode for read-only codebase questions with minimal latency.
